dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, my! Do you really need to eat that much, <$cdef(27)>Machoke</color>?

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Well, yeah! You gotta eat up if you wanna bulk up!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>So I’m mega excited to try whatever you’re COOKIN’ up
for the party! <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,8)>How many extra servings can I have? Hope
it’s at least in the double-digits!

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,667)><$voicel(2,3)>Well now—this rather puts me in a pickle. I hadn’t even
made up my mind on what to make yet...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>And now, to complicate things further, I have to factor in
sweeties like you with extra-hearty appetites!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! What marvelous timing!
You
heard
what
we
were
just
talking
about, right?

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>There are probably plenty of other sweeties like <$cdef(27)>Machoke
here who eat quite a lot.
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,5)>In fact, I alone may not be capable of making enough party
food for everyone!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>So I was hoping YOU could help out by doing a lot of the
cooking as well, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I wouldn’t ask you to make anything more than the usual
dishes, of course.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>You know, the ones I taught you? <$cdef(27)>Salad, <$cdef(27)>bread, <$cdef(27)>hamburger
steak... Any of those will do!
<$comeff(2,12)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>But since it IS a party, I’d at least like you to put the food
on plates that suit the occasion!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>You could make <$cdef(27)>salad, <$cdef(27)>bread, <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak... Any of
those will do!
<$comeff(2,12)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>But since it IS a party, I’d at least like you to put the food
on plates that suit the occasion!
You came up with a <$cdef(27)>recipe </color>for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(400)></color>!
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh! <$cdef(27)><fcap><fqty(2)><$ifull(400)></color> would be perfect!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>OK, could you please make <$cdef(27)>five <$ifull(400)> and put
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>various dishes on them?

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I just know when the other Pokémon see a lot of
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(400)> all lined up at the venue...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,7)>they’re sure to get oh-so excited, and the <$cdef(27)>mood will shift
for the better!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Would you be a sweetie pie and make <$cdef(27)>five <$cdef(27)><$ifull(400)>
and <$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>load them up with an assortment of different dishes?

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I just know when the other Pokémon see a lot of
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(400)> all lined up at the venue...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,7)>they’re sure to get oh-so excited, and the <$cdef(27)>mood will shift
for the better!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you got all that food
ready?
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Thank
you
so
much,
sweetie!
That’s
a
huge help!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Do you think this has improved the <$cdef(27)>mood a bit?
It must have!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>There appear to be three different ways to raise the <$cdef(27)>mood
around here.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>The first is by setting up exciting items in the party venue.

<$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>And I in particular would be most pleased if you placed
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)> that have been <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)>d!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m certain there are lots of other items that would help
liven things up too, though.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>The second way is by having Pokémon dance!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>If you find a Pokémon who’s good at <$spwicon(14)><$cdef(27)>hyping folks up
and bring them near <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(274)>,
<$voicel(1,6)>they’ll
move
to
the
music
and
liven
up
the place!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>But it might feel a bit lonely with only one
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(14)> Pokémon...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,9)>I suggest you find several and bring them here!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>And the final way is by placing <$cdef(27)><$ifull(400)> in
the venue.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Dish up food you’ve made on the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(400)> and
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>put them in the venue.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>That’s sure to lift the spirits of the most food-motivated
Pokémon, and the <$cdef(27)>mood should rise.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>That about sums everything up.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>If you’d like to know how the <$cdef(27)>mood is doing at the
moment, you should ask <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(274)>.

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>We need your help to throw the most festive party
imaginable! <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>It’s up to you to get the <$cdef(27)>mood up to <$cdef(27)>100!
